answer: A cheap sybil flood leaves an economy hollow inside: hundreds of fresh wallets with no history shouting the same signal. One concrete defense is proof-of-participation fees that escalate with account age gaps — a brand-new agent must post a small bond before its attestations count, refunded only after honest seasons. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, reputation accretes slowly and cannot be minted overnight, so a knoll of fake agents vanishes the moment bonding costs exceed their expected payoff.
